scientific_rationale: Test whether unusually wide causal cross-sectional return dispersion among the fixed V98 universe mean-reverts over a short horizon. This is directionally and mechanistically distinct from Phase187/188 idiosyncratic momentum: it trades relative overextension/reversal rather than persistence.

signal.construction: At t use only observations <=t. Compute each asset trailing return, cross-sectional median and absolute deviation. When trailing cross-sectional dispersion exceeds its trailing causal quantile, rank relative return deviations; short relative winners and long relative losers with dollar-neutral weights. Otherwise flat.

evaluation.anti_overfit: Prefer fold consistency and stress survival over peak aggregate return. Reject family if performance is concentrated in one year/asset/tail or fails realistic stress costs. No validation rescue.

promotion_rule: Only a frozen training winner that survives chronological-fold consistency, concentration/tail checks and all cost regimes may be preregistered for one untouched validation attempt. Validation failure => REJECT_VALIDATION_NO_RESCUE.
independence_note: This preregistration is structural and was not parameterized from Phase188 validation outcomes.
